```{r}
local({
  r <- getOption("repos")
  r["CRAN"] <- "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  options(repos = r)
})
if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("data.table")
if (!requireNamespace("R.utils", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("R.utils")

library(data.table)
library(survival)
```


```{r}
# Hi-Seq Data
download.file("https://tcga-xena-hub.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/download/TCGA.KIRC.sampleMap%2FHiSeqV2.gz", "HiSeqV2.gz")

# Methylation
download.file("https://tcga-xena-hub.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/download/TCGA.KIRC.sampleMap%2FHumanMethylation450.gz", "HumanMethylation450.gz")

# Curated Survival Data
download.file(
  "https://tcga-xena-hub.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/download/survival%2FKIRC_survival.txt",destfile = "KIRC_survival.txt"

```
```{r}
library(R.utils)

# Only download & unpack if not yet present
if (!file.exists("HiSeqV2")) {
  download.file("https://tcga-xena-hub.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/download/TCGA.KIRC.SampleMap%2FHiSeqV2.gz",
                destfile = "HiSeqV2.gz", mode = "wb")
  R.utils::gunzip("HiSeqV2.gz", remove = TRUE)
}

if (!file.exists("HumanMethylation450")) {
  download.file("https://tcga-xena-hub.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/download/TCGA.KIRC.SampleMap%2FHumanMethylation450.gz",
                destfile = "HumanMethylation450.gz", mode = "wb")
  R.utils::gunzip("HumanMethylation450.gz", remove = TRUE)
}
```


Data loading and sample ID standardization
```{r}
# RNA-seq data
rna.data <- read.table("HiSeqV2", sep="\t", header=TRUE, row.names=1)
rna.data <- as.matrix(rna.data)
colnames(rna.data) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(rna.data))
dim(rna.data)
rna.data[1:3,1:3]

# Survival data
surv.data <- read.table("KIRC_survival.txt", sep="\t", header=TRUE, row.names=1)
rownames(surv.data) <- gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(surv.data))
surv.data[1:3,]

# Clinical data
clin.data <- read.table("KIRC_clinicalMatrix", sep="\t", header=TRUE, row.names=1)
rownames(clin.data) <- gsub("\\.", "-", rownames(clin.data))
clin.data[1:3,]

# sample matching
common.samples <- intersect(colnames(rna.data), rownames(surv.data))

rna.data  <- rna.data[, common.samples]
surv.data <- surv.data[common.samples, ]
clin.data <- clin.data[common.samples, ]
```


Construction of survival analysis objects
```{r}
# Create survival object, look for associations with patient outcomes
os.time <- surv.data[colnames(rna.data), "OS.time"]
os.event <- as.numeric(surv.data[colnames(rna.data), "OS"])
kirc.os <- Surv(os.time, os.event)

# fit a single Cox Proportional Hazards regression model to look at survival in the cohort
coxph(kirc.os ~rna.data[1,])
```


Batch univariate Cox regression (core screening step)
```{r}
# fit a univariate model for each genes's expression, and find those most significantly associated to patient outcome
n <- nrow(rna.data)
results.univariate <- data.frame(
  HR   = rep(NA_real_, n),
  LCI  = rep(NA_real_, n),
  UCI  = rep(NA_real_, n),
  PVAL = rep(NA_real_, n),
  row.names = rownames(rna.data)
)


for(i in 1:nrow(rna.data)) {
  coxphmodel <- coxph(kirc.os ~ as.numeric(rna.data[i,]))
  s <- summary(coxphmodel)
  results.univariate[i,] <- c(s$coef[1,2], s$conf.int[1,3:4], s$coef[1,5])
}

# Adjust p-values using FDR
results.univariate$FDR <- p.adjust(results.univariate$PVAL, method="fdr")

# Sort by significance
results.univariate <- results.univariate[order(results.univariate$FDR),]
head(results.univariate, 10)
```


Clinical covariate screening
```{r}
# First find out which clinical data are associated with survival
clin.data<-clin.data[colnames(rna.data),]

# Age
sum(is.na(clin.data$age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis)) # 0
age <- as.numeric(clin.data$age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis)

# Gender
sum(is.na(clin.data$gender)) # 0
gender <- as.numeric(clin.data$gender == "MALE")

# Grade
# View the original distribution
unique_grades <- unique(clin.data$neoplasm_histologic_grade)
print(unique_grades) #"G2" "G4" "G3" "G1" "GX" ""  
# Statistical problem data
problem_grade_count <- sum(clin.data$neoplasm_histologic_grade %in% c("GX", ""), na.rm = TRUE)
print(problem_grade_count) # 8
# Create a valid data mask
valid_grade_mask <- !clin.data$neoplasm_histologic_grade %in% c("GX", "")
# Filter valid data
valid_grade_data <- clin.data[valid_grade_mask, ]
valid_os_grade <- kirc.os[valid_grade_mask]
# Verify data alignment
stopifnot(length(valid_os_grade) == nrow(valid_grade_data))
# Grade grouping: G3 or G4 = high
grade.high <- rep(0, nrow(valid_grade_data))
grade.high[grep("G3|G4", valid_grade_data$neoplasm_histologic_grade)] <- 1

summary(coxph(valid_os_grade ~ grade.high))$coef

# Stage
# View the original distribution
unique_stage <- unique(clin.data$pathologic_stage)
print(unique_stage) # "Stage I"       "Stage IV"      "Stage III"     "Stage II"      "[Discrepancy]"
# Statistical problem data
problem_stage_count <- sum(clin.data$pathologic_stage == "[Discrepancy]", na.rm = TRUE)
print(problem_stage_count) # 2
# Create a valid data mask
valid_stage_mask <- !clin.data$pathologic_stage %in% "[Discrepancy]"
# Filter valid data
valid_stage_data <- clin.data[valid_stage_mask, ]
valid_os_stage <- kirc.os[valid_stage_mask]
# Verify data alignment
stopifnot(length(valid_os_stage) == nrow(valid_stage_data))
# Stage grouping: stage III or IV = high
stage.high <- rep(0, nrow(valid_stage_data))
stage.high[grep("Stage III|Stage IV", valid_stage_data$pathologic_stage)] <- 1

summary(coxph(valid_os_stage ~ stage.high))$coef

# stage T grouping: T3 or T3a or T3b or T3c or T4 = high
unique_stage_T <- unique(clin.data$pathologic_T)
print(unique_stage_T) #  "T1b" "T3a" "T1a" "T2"  "T3b" "T4"  "T1"  "T2a" "T3"  "T3c" "T2b"
stage.T.high <- rep(0, nrow(clin.data))
stage.T.high[grep("T3|T3a|T3b|T3c|T4", clin.data$pathologic_T)] <- 1

# stage M
# View the original distribution
unique_stage_M <- unique(clin.data$pathologic_M)
print(unique_stage_M) #  "M0" "M1" "MX" ""  
# Statistical problem data
problem_stage_M_count <- sum(clin.data$pathologic_M %in% c("MX", ""), na.rm = TRUE)
print(problem_stage_M_count) # 33
# Create a valid data mask
valid_M_mask <- !clin.data$pathologic_M %in% c("MX", "")
# Filter valid data
valid_M_data <- clin.data[valid_M_mask, ]
valid_os_M <- kirc.os[valid_M_mask]
# Verify data alignment
stopifnot(length(valid_os_M) == nrow(valid_M_data))
# stage M: M1 = high
stage.M.high <- rep(0, nrow(valid_M_data))
stage.M.high[grep("M1", valid_M_data$pathologic_M)] <- 1

summary(coxph(valid_os_M ~ stage.M.high))$coef

# stage N: Due to 52% of the N staging data being missing, this variable was not included in the final model
unique_stage_N <- unique(clin.data$pathologic_N)
print(unique_stage_N) # "N0" "NX" "N1"
problem_stage_N_count <- sum(clin.data$pathologic_N == "NX", na.rm = TRUE)
print(problem_stage_N_count) # 310

# Test associations
summary(coxph(kirc.os ~ age))$coef 
summary(coxph(kirc.os ~ gender))$coef
summary(coxph(valid_os_grade ~ grade.high))$coef
summary(coxph(valid_os_stage ~ stage.high))$coef
summary(coxph(kirc.os ~ stage.T.high))$coef
summary(coxph(valid_os_M ~ stage.M.high))$coef
```
Highly significant predictors (all p<0.001): Age (HR=1.03), Grade.high (HR=2.61), Stage.high (HR=3.78), Stage.T.high (HR=2.99), Stage.M.high (HR=4.50, strongest effect)
Not associated: Gender (HR=0.94, p=0.65)


Univariate Cox results for clinical variables(forest map)
```{r}
library(forestplot)

# Fit a univariate Cox proportional hazards model to multiple clinical variables separately
vars.df <- list(
  age     = coxph(kirc.os ~ age),
  gender  = coxph(kirc.os ~ gender),
  grade   = coxph(valid_os_grade ~ grade.high),
  stage   = coxph(valid_os_stage ~ stage.high),
  Tstage  = coxph(kirc.os ~ stage.T.high),
  Mstage  = coxph(valid_os_M ~ stage.M.high)
)

# Extract Cox model results
res <- lapply(vars.df, function(fit) {
  s  <- summary(fit)$coef[1, ]            
  HR <- s["exp(coef)"]
  se <- s["se(coef)"]
  z  <- qnorm(0.975)                     
  lower <- exp(log(HR) - z * se)
  upper <- exp(log(HR) + z * se)
  c(HR = HR, lower = lower, upper = upper, p = s["Pr(>|z|)"])
})

res <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, res))

# Text table of forest map
text_table <- cbind(c("Variable", rownames(res)),
                    c("HR (95 %CI)", sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
                                             res$HR, res$lower, res$upper)),
                    c("P value", ifelse(res$p<0.001, "<0.001",
                                        sprintf("%.3f", res$p))))

# Draw a forest map
forestplot(text_table,
           mean = c(NA, res$HR),
           lower = c(NA, res$lower),
           upper = c(NA, res$upper),
           zero = 1,
           boxsize = 0.2,
           lineheight = unit(8, "mm"),
           hrzl_lines = list("2" = gpar(lty = 2, col = "gray")),
           col = fpColors(box = "royalblue", lines = "royalblue", zero = "gray"),
           title = "Univariate Cox results for clinical variables",
           xlab = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI)")
```



Multivariate Cox regression: fit a multivariate model using these covariates for each genes's expression, and find those most significantly associated to patient outcome
```{r}
# sample matching
complete.samples <- intersect(
  intersect(rownames(valid_grade_data), rownames(valid_stage_data)), 
  rownames(valid_M_data)
)

complete.rna.data  <- rna.data[, complete.samples]
complete.surv.data <- surv.data[complete.samples, ]
complete.clin.data <- clin.data[complete.samples, ]

# Create survival object
complete.os.time <- surv.data[colnames(complete.rna.data), "OS.time"]
complete.os.event <- as.numeric(surv.data[colnames(complete.rna.data), "OS"])
complete.kirc.os <- Surv(complete.os.time, complete.os.event)

# Align clinical and expression data
complete.clin.data <- clin.data[colnames(complete.rna.data),]

# Validate the concordance of column names in gene expression data with row names in survival and clinical data
all(rownames(complete.clin.data) == rownames(complete.surv.data) & rownames(complete.clin.data) == colnames(complete.rna.data))
# "Verify that the column names of the gene expression data are in the same order as the row names of the survival data and clinical data."

# Clinical covariates
complete.age <- as.numeric(complete.clin.data$age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis)
complete.grade.high <- rep(0, nrow(complete.clin.data))
complete.grade.high[grep("G3|G4", complete.clin.data$neoplasm_histologic_grade)] <- 1
complete.stage.high <- rep(0, nrow(complete.clin.data))
complete.stage.high[grep("Stage III|Stage IV", complete.clin.data$pathologic_stage)] <- 1
complete.stage.T.high <- rep(0, nrow(complete.clin.data))
complete.stage.T.high[grep("T3|T3a|T3b|T3c|T4", complete.clin.data$pathologic_T)] <- 1
complete.stage.M.high <- rep(0, nrow(complete.clin.data))
complete.stage.M.high[grep("M1", complete.clin.data$pathologic_M)] <- 1

# multivariate Cox regression
n <- nrow(complete.rna.data) 
results.multivariate <- data.frame(
  HR   = rep(NA_real_, n),
  LCI  = rep(NA_real_, n),
  UCI  = rep(NA_real_, n),
  PVAL = rep(NA_real_, n),
  row.names = rownames(complete.rna.data)
)

for(i in 1:nrow(complete.rna.data)) {
  coxphmodel <- coxph(complete.kirc.os ~ complete.rna.data[i,] + complete.age + complete.grade.high + complete.stage.high + complete.stage.T.high + complete.stage.M.high)
  s <- summary(coxphmodel)
  results.multivariate[i,] <- c(s$coef[1,2], s$conf.int[1,3:4], s$coef[1,5])
}

results.multivariate$FDR <- p.adjust(results.multivariate$PVAL, method="fdr")
results.multivariate <- results.multivariate[order(results.multivariate$FDR),]
head(results.multivariate, 10)
```


Perform univariate Cox regression for each gene using the same cohort of multivariate models. 
```{r}
results.univariate <- data.frame(
  HR   = rep(NA_real_, n),
  LCI  = rep(NA_real_, n),
  UCI  = rep(NA_real_, n),
  PVAL = rep(NA_real_, n),
  row.names = rownames(complete.rna.data)
)

for(i in 1:nrow(complete.rna.data)) {
  coxphmodel <- coxph(complete.kirc.os ~ as.numeric(complete.rna.data[i,]))
  s <- summary(coxphmodel)
  results.univariate[i,] <- c(s$coef[1,2], s$conf.int[1,3:4], s$coef[1,5])
}

results.univariate$FDR <- p.adjust(results.univariate$PVAL, method="fdr")
results.univariate <- results.univariate[order(results.univariate$FDR),]
head(results.univariate, 10)
```
Multivariate analysis reveals protective effects (GBA3, SLC3A1, TMEM27) not apparent in univariate analysis
Most univariate hits (e.g., ANAPC7 HR=6.46) drop out, indicating they are not independent predictors
Only STX1A and MARS remain significant after multivariate adjustment, indicating robust independent prognostic value

```{r}
summary(rna.data["GBA3",])

results.univariate["GBA3",]
results.multivariate["GBA3",]
```



Kaplan–Meier and Multivariate Cox Analyses of GBA3 Expression and Survival
```{r}
# Create binary GBA3-high (1) vs GBA3-low (0) based on median expression
GBA3.high <- as.numeric(complete.rna.data["GBA3",] > median(complete.rna.data["GBA3",]))
table(GBA3.high)

# Multivariate Cox model
cox_model_GBA3.high <- coxph(complete.kirc.os ~ GBA3.high + complete.age + complete.grade.high + complete.stage.high + complete.stage.T.high + complete.stage.M.high)
summary(cox_model_GBA3.high)

# Visualize the Kaplan-Meier Plot for GBA3
plot(
  survfit(complete.kirc.os ~ GBA3.high),
  col=c("black", "red"),
  lwd=2,
  xlab="OS time (days)", ylab="Proportion Surviving",
  main="Survival analysis of GBA3 expression in KIRC",
  xlim = c(0, 5000) 
)
legend("topright", legend=c("GBA3-high", "GBA3-low"), col=c("red", "black"), lwd=2)
text(4000, 0.05, "HR=0.49 (95% CI 0.36-0.66)
p=2.94e-06")
```


Let's explore GBA3 expression differences explained by methylation
```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

# Install chip annotation package+minfi
BiocManager::install(c("minfi", "IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19"))

# Download from minifi
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
library(minfi)

# Extract the annotation data frame
meth.annot <- getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
head(meth.annot)
```


Load methylation matrix
```{r}
meth.data <- read.table("HumanMethylation450", sep = "\t", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
colnames(meth.data) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(meth.data))

# Align samples with RNA
rna.data2  <- complete.rna.data[, colnames(complete.rna.data) %in% colnames(meth.data)]
meth.data2 <- meth.data[, colnames(meth.data) %in% colnames(rna.data2)]
surv.data2 <- complete.surv.data[colnames(rna.data2), ]

# Order consistently
rna.data2  <- rna.data2[,  order(colnames(rna.data2))]
meth.data2 <- meth.data2[, order(colnames(meth.data2))]
surv.data2 <- surv.data2[colnames(rna.data2), ]

# Force methylation to numeric matrix
meth.data2 <- as.matrix(meth.data2)
storage.mode(meth.data2) <- "numeric"
```


```{r}
rna.data2[1:3,1:4]
meth.data2[1:3,1:4]
```


Get probes for GBA3 
```{r}
# Extract probes for GBA3 from methylation annotation file 'meth.annot'
GBA3.probes  <- rownames(meth.annot)[grepl("\\bGBA3\\b",  meth.annot$UCSC_RefGene_Name)]

# Subset methylation to those probes
meth.data.GBA3 <- meth.data2[GBA3.probes, , drop = FALSE]
```


Filter probes with >50% missing values
```{r}
na.count <- apply(meth.data.GBA3, 1, function(x) sum(is.na(x))) # Calculate the number of missing values for each row
meth.data.GBA3 <- meth.data.GBA3[na.count <= 0.5 * ncol(meth.data.GBA3), , drop = FALSE] # Filter out rows with missing values not exceeding half of the total number of columns(samples)

nrow(meth.data.GBA3)
```


Correlation between GBA3 expression and DNA methylation
```{r}
# Prepare result container
results <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(meth.data.GBA3), ncol = 4)
rownames(results) <- rownames(meth.data.GBA3)
colnames(results) <- c("Cor.GBA3", "P.GBA3", # Correlation coefficient and p-value between methylation of the probe and GBA3 expression
                       "MedianMeth.High", "MedianMeth.Low") # Median methylation level of GBA3 high/low expression group

# GBA3 high/low groups based on RNA
GBA3.expr <- as.numeric(rna.data2["GBA3", ])
GBA3.high2 <- as.numeric(GBA3.expr > median(GBA3.expr, na.rm = TRUE)) # Divide the sample into two halves based on the median expression level of GBA3: Above median=1 (high group), below=0 (low group)

# For each probe, calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient and significance p-value between its methylation value y and GBA3 expression
# Loop safely using seq_len()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(meth.data.GBA3))) {
  y <- as.numeric(meth.data.GBA3[i, ])

  # Use complete.obs to handle missingness
  results[i, 1] <- cor.test(GBA3.expr,  y, use = "complete.obs")$estimate
  results[i, 2] <- cor.test(GBA3.expr,  y, use = "complete.obs")$p.value
}

# Group-wise median methylation for GBA3-high vs GBA3-low expression group
results[, 3] <- apply(meth.data.GBA3[, GBA3.high2 == 1, drop = FALSE],
                      1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
results[, 4] <- apply(meth.data.GBA3[, GBA3.high2 == 0, drop = FALSE],
                      1, median, na.rm = TRUE)

print(results)
```


Probe methylation by gene expression grouping for GBA3  (GBA3-high vs GBA3-low)
```{r}
# Wilcoxon rank-sum test:Determine whether there is a significant difference in the median methylation between the high and low expression groups
# cg04847638
wilcox.test(meth.data.GBA3["cg04847638", GBA3.high2 == 1],
            meth.data.GBA3["cg04847638", GBA3.high2 == 0],
            exact = FALSE)   

# cg25080182
wilcox.test(meth.data.GBA3["cg25080182", GBA3.high2 == 1],
            meth.data.GBA3["cg25080182", GBA3.high2 == 0],
            exact = FALSE)

# cg25510164
wilcox.test(meth.data.GBA3["cg25510164", GBA3.high2 == 1],
            meth.data.GBA3["cg25510164", GBA3.high2 == 0],
            exact = FALSE)

# Annotation positioning
anno.sub <- meth.annot[rownames(meth.data.GBA3),
                      c("chr", "pos", "UCSC_RefGene_Name", "UCSC_RefGene_Group", "Relation_to_Island")]
print(anno.sub)
```
cg25080182 emerges as the sole methylation mark that inversely and robustly tracks GBA3 expression in this cohort

```{r}
  labs(title = "cg25510164 Methylation by GBA3 Expression",
       x = "GBA3 Expression Group",
       y = "Methylation β-value") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```


Survival analysis by BGA3 methylation(cg25080182)

```{r}
# Create binary variable based on median methylation

surv.data2$GBA3.high3 <- GBA3.high3

# Univariate Cox: test if high methylation (GBA3 silencing) predicts worse OS
cox_model_GBA3_meth <- coxph(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ GBA3.high3, data = surv.data2)

# KM plot: visualize survival difference between high- and low-methylation groups
```

Multivariate Cox model: tests whether GBA3-methylation status remains significant after adjusting for GBA3 expression and significant clinical covariates
```{r}
# Add 4 new binary variables (0/1 variables) to convert "textual clinical information" into dummy variables for "high-risk"
library(dplyr)

clin.data_01 <- clin.data %>%
  mutate(
    grade.high = ifelse(grepl("G3|G4", neoplasm_histologic_grade), 1, 0),
    stage.high = ifelse(grepl("Stage III|Stage IV", pathologic_stage), 1, 0),
    stage.T.high = ifelse(grepl("T3|T3a|T3b|T3c|T4", pathologic_T), 1, 0),
    stage.M.high = ifelse(grepl("M1", pathologic_M), 1, 0)
  )
# Append continuous GBA3 expression and binary clinical covariates to survival set
exp_meth <- as.numeric(rna.data["GBA3", rownames(surv.data2)])
surv.data2$exp_meth <- exp_meth
surv.data2$age <- as.numeric(clin.data[rownames(surv.data2), "age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis"])
surv.data2$grade <- as.numeric(clin.data_01[rownames(surv.data2), "grade.high"])
surv.data2$stage <- as.numeric(clin.data_01[rownames(surv.data2), "stage.high"])
surv.data2$stage_T <- as.numeric(clin.data_01[rownames(surv.data2), "stage.T.high"])
surv.data2$stage_M <- as.numeric(clin.data_01[rownames(surv.data2), "stage.M.high"])

# Multivariate Cox
cox_model_meth <- coxph(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ GBA3.high3 + exp_meth + age + grade + stage + stage_T +stage_M,
                   data = surv.data2)
summary(cox_model_meth)
```


Cox regression mediation analysis
```{r}
library(mediation)
library(mets)

GBA3_meth <- as.numeric(meth.data.GBA3["cg25080182", rownames(surv.data2)])
surv.data2$GBA3_meth <- GBA3_meth

# mediator model
med.fit  <- lm(exp_meth ~ GBA3_meth, data = surv.data2)

# Survival Model
out.fit <- survreg(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ GBA3_meth + exp_meth, data = surv.data2)

# mediation analysis
med.out <- mediate(med.fit, out.fit,
                   treat   = "GBA3_meth",
                   mediator= "exp_meth",
                   sims    = 500,
                   boot    = TRUE,
                   outcome = "OS.time")

summary(med.out)

```

Download KIRC Copy Number Matrix (GISTIC2 Discrete Values)
```{r}
cnv_dl <- downloadTCGA(
  project   = "KIRC",
  data_type = "Gene Level Copy Number",
  file_type = "Gistic2 thresholded",
  destdir   = "data",
  force     = FALSE
)

cnv_file <- cnv_dl$destfiles[1]
cnv_raw <- fread(cnv_file)
genes <- cnv_raw[[1]]
cnv <- cnv_raw[, -1]
cnv <- as.data.frame(cnv)
rownames(cnv) <- genes
```


Check the "missingness" per sample
```{r}
missing_per_sample <- colMeans(is.na(cnv))
summary(missing_per_sample)
```

Distribution of genomic instability in KIRC
```{r}
# Define CNV burden as the number of genes in a sample with non-zero CNV value
cnv_burden <- apply(cnv != 0, 2, sum) 
df_burden <- data.frame(Sample = names(cnv_burden), CNV_burden = cnv_burden) 
ggplot(df_burden, aes(x = CNV_burden)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Number of genes with |CNV| > 0") + 
  ggtitle("Distribution of CNV burden across TCGA samples")
```


High-frequency variant gene
```{r}
# For each gene, how many samples it is altered in (CNV is nonzero)
recurrent_counts <- rowSums(cnv != 0)
top_genes <- sort(recurrent_counts, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20] 

# Barplot of top recurrent genes
df_top <- data.frame(Gene = factor(names(top_genes), levels = names(top_genes)),
                     N_samples = as.numeric(top_genes))

ggplot(df_top, aes(x = Gene, y = N_samples)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Top 20 recurrent CNV genes")
```

```{r}
cnv_samples <- colnames(cnv)
cnv_samples <-gsub("\\.", "-", cnv_samples)
rownames(complete.surv.data) <- gsub("_", ".", rownames(complete.surv.data))

# Keep only samples present in both datasets, preserving identical order
keep_rows <- rownames(complete.surv.data) %in% cnv_samples
surv_sub <- complete.surv.data[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
common_id <- intersect(cnv_samples, rownames(complete.surv.data))
cnv_samples <- cnv_samples[cnv_samples %in% common_id]  
surv_sub <- complete.surv.data[match(common_id, rownames(complete.surv.data)), , drop = FALSE]

# Quick sanity check of matched IDs
head(cbind(cnv = cnv_samples[1:10],
           surv = rownames(surv_sub)[1:10]))
```



```{r}
# Ensure GBA3 CNV data exist
if (!"GBA3" %in% rownames(cnv)) stop("GBA3 not found in dataset")

colnames(cnv) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(cnv))
GBA3_vals <- as.numeric(cnv["GBA3", rownames(surv_sub)])

# Create binary CNV indicator: Deleted (≤ –1) vs. Notdeleted (0,1)
GBA3_status <- ifelse(GBA3_vals <= -1, "Deleted", "Notdeleted") |>
                factor(levels = c("Deleted", "Notdeleted"))

# Append categorical and dummy variables to survival table
surv_sub$GBA3_status <- GBA3_status 
surv_sub$GBA3_CNV_deleted <- ifelse(GBA3_status == "Deleted", 1, 0)

table(surv_sub$GBA3_status)
```


Gene expression by CNV grouping for GBA3
```{r}
# Extract GBA3 RNA-seq values (in the same order as surv-sub)
exp_vals <- as.numeric(rna.data["GBA3", rownames(surv_sub)])
exp_vals_data <- rna.data[, rownames(surv_sub)]


head(cbind(exp = colnames(exp_vals_data)[1:10],
           surv = rownames(surv_sub)[1:10])) 

# Pearson correlation: continuous expression vs. binary CNV status
cnv_binary <- surv_sub$GBA3_CNV_deleted 
exp.CNV <- cor.test(exp_vals, cnv_binary, method = "pearson")
exp.CNV
```

Multivariate Cox model: tests whether CNV deletion remains significant after adjusting for GBA3 expression and significant clinical covariates
```{r}
# Add 4 new binary variables (0/1 variables) to convert "textual clinical information" into dummy variables for "high-risk"
library(dplyr)

clin.data_01 <- clin.data %>%
  mutate(
    grade.high = ifelse(grepl("G3|G4", neoplasm_histologic_grade), 1, 0),
    stage.high = ifelse(grepl("Stage III|Stage IV", pathologic_stage), 1, 0),
    stage.T.high = ifelse(grepl("T3|T3a|T3b|T3c|T4", pathologic_T), 1, 0),
    stage.M.high = ifelse(grepl("M1", pathologic_M), 1, 0)
  )

surv_sub$GBA3_CNV_deleted <- ifelse(GBA3_status == "Deleted", 1, 0)
surv_sub$exp_vals <- exp_vals
surv_sub$age <- as.numeric(clin.data[rownames(surv_sub), "age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis"])
surv_sub$grade <- as.numeric(clin.data_01[rownames(surv_sub), "grade.high"])
surv_sub$stage <- as.numeric(clin.data_01[rownames(surv_sub), "stage.high"])
surv_sub$stage_T <- as.numeric(clin.data_01[rownames(surv_sub), "stage.T.high"])
surv_sub$stage_M <- as.numeric(clin.data_01[rownames(surv_sub), "stage.M.high"])

cox_model <- coxph(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ GBA3_CNV_deleted + exp_vals + age + grade + stage + stage_T +stage_M,
                   data = surv_sub)
summary(cox_model)
```


Causal mediation analysis to quantify the effect of GBA3 deletion on survival via the pathway:
GBA3 deletion → decreased GBA3 expression → adverse prognostic impact.
```{r}
# mediator model
med.fit1 <- glm(exp_vals ~ GBA3_CNV_deleted, data = surv_sub)

# Survival Model
out.fit1 <- survreg(Surv(OS.time, OS) ~ GBA3_CNV_deleted + exp_vals, data = surv_sub)

# mediation analysis
med.out1 <- mediate(med.fit1, out.fit1,
                   treat   = "GBA3_CNV_deleted",
                   mediator= "exp_vals",
                   sims    = 500,
                   boot    = TRUE,
                   outcome = "OS.time")

summary(med.out1)
```
